method: Prices were read primarily from motofichas.com.mx, a Mexican motorcycle trade/enthusiast reference site that republishes each maker's current Mexican list price (IVA included) per model, confirmed where possible against the maker's own Mexico site (Honda's XR150L price and spec, read on hondamotored.com.mx and cross-checked via web search, matched the motofichas figure exactly). Where a model's own page quoted both a regular and a promotional price, the regular (non-promotional) list price was recorded. ATV/UTV/side-by-side models (Honda TRX/Pioneer/Talon, Yamaha YFM/Grizzly, Suzuki KingQuad, Kymco MXU, CFMoto CFORCE) were excluded as out of scope for a motorcycle/scooter catalog. Models marked 'N.D.' (no data) on the source page for price were skipped rather than estimated. No tank capacity, battery kWh or kerb weight figures were available on the pages read except for the Honda XR150L (tank and kerb weight read on the same motofichas detail page), so all other tankL/batteryKwh/kerbKg fields are null rather than guessed. MV Agusta was dropped afterwards (2026-10-05): the only Mexican prices read were for its 2018 to 2020 model years, not a current list price.
